item.title: Re: Cliche?
item.content:encoded:
That’s because, in the hands of inexperienced authors, those things (that is, the things specifically listed in the rules) tend to wind up as crap that gets downvoted into deletion range within hours. If you spend a couple weeks on most recently created, or if you look at one of the staff’s deletion threads, this is pretty clear.

The whole point of this contest was for experienced authors to try to use those tropes in a more effective way to show that it can be done.

item.title: Re: I came in late :(
item.content:encoded:
Hi there!

-Can we use elements from existing scp such as mentions, inclusions, etc?

If you feel as though your article would benefit from the inclusion of crosslinking to another existing work, feel free to go for it. I do, however, suggest you read the Crosslinks Guide. If you are entering with a tale or GoI format, feel free to crosslink and use existing work to your heart's content, as the stigma against crosslinking on those is much less.

item.title: Re: I came in late :(
item.content:encoded:
The posting period lasts for a full month — it STARTS on January 1. But you'll have plenty of time to come up with a draft and get lots of good feedback before you post. :)

From my reading of the rules, it seems like these articles should fulfill all the same criteria as non-contest SCPs and Tales. So sensible crosslinking would probably be okay, though I don't think it would be good to have an entry rely on another SCP too heavily.
